meta.project: SIMSA — Sistem Informasi Manajemen Surat dan Arsip

product_overview: SIMSA digitises end-to-end management of official correspondence and archives for Kementerian ATR/BPN, covering incoming/outgoing letters, archive lifecycle, retention scheduling, storage tracking, lending, disposition, and regulatory form generation. The system provides role-based access, audit trails, export/print capabilities, and compliance with Permen ATR/BPN regulations.
core_goals: Digitise and automate the full lifecycle of surat (letters) and arsip (archives) from registration through disposition in compliance with Permen ATR/BPN regulations.
Provide secure, auditable, and role-based access to archival records and workflows (incl. lending, retention, and disposal) for organisational units.
Support operational efficiency via searchable records, bulk import/export, printable regulatory forms (33 Formulir), and dashboard KPIs.
Ensure data integrity and security via session-based auth, file validation, audit logging, and retention/approval workflows.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User authentication and session management (email/password, Google OAuth, sign-out, get session info) using Better Auth.
user_flows: Sign in with email and password via POST /api/auth/sign-in/email -> Receive 200 OK with session cookie -> Get current session via GET /api/auth/get-session -> See user session info
Sign up with email and password via POST /api/auth/sign-up/email -> Receive 201 Created -> Sign in via POST /api/auth/sign-in/email -> Receive 200 OK and session cookie
Sign in with Google via POST /api/auth/sign-in/social -> Receive 200 OK with session cookie -> Get current session via GET /api/auth/get-session -> See social-linked account info
Sign out via POST /api/auth/sign-out -> Receive 204 No Content -> Get current session via GET /api/auth/get-session -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
Attempt sign in with wrong password via POST /api/auth/sign-in/email -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> See error 'Invalid credentials'

features.name: Incoming Mail Management (Surat Masuk)
features.description: CRUD and lifecycle operations for incoming letters including attachments, classification mapping, disposisi and status tracking.
user_flows: List incoming mails via GET /api/surat-masuk -> See paginated list of incoming mails
Create new incoming mail with attachments via POST /api/surat-masuk -> Receive 201 Created with new mail ID -> View created mail via GET /api/surat-masuk/:id -> See mail details and attachments
Update incoming mail via PUT /api/surat-masuk/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> View updated mail via GET /api/surat-masuk/:id -> See updated fields
Delete incoming mail via DELETE /api/surat-masuk/:id -> Receive 204 No Content -> List via GET /api/surat-masuk -> Deleted mail not present
Attempt to create incoming mail with missing required field via POST /api/surat-masuk -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> See validation error 'nomor_surat is required'

features.name: Outgoing Mail Management (Surat Keluar)
features.description: Create, list, view, update and delete outgoing letters including metadata and attachments.
user_flows: List outgoing mails via GET /api/surat-keluar -> See paginated list of outgoing mails
Create new outgoing mail via POST /api/surat-keluar -> Receive 201 Created with new ID -> View via GET /api/surat-keluar/:id -> See full metadata
Update outgoing mail via PUT /api/surat-keluar/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> View via GET /api/surat-keluar/:id -> See updated metadata
Delete outgoing mail via DELETE /api/surat-keluar/:id -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/surat-keluar should not include deleted item
Attempt to fetch outgoing mail without auth via GET /api/surat-keluar -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> See authentication error

features.name: Archive Management (Arsip)
features.description: Manage archive records across their lifecycle: creation, classification, storage location, metadata, and deletion.
user_flows: List archives via GET /api/arsip -> See archives list with filters
Create new archive record via POST /api/arsip -> Receive 201 Created with archive ID -> View via GET /api/arsip/:id -> See archive metadata and storage info
Update archive record via PUT /api/arsip/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> View via GET /api/arsip/:id -> See updated record
Delete archive via DELETE /api/arsip/:id -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/arsip should not include deleted archive
Attempt to create archive with invalid classification via POST /api/arsip -> Receive 422 Unprocessable Entity -> See validation error 'classification code invalid'

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Provide summary statistics and KPIs for mails and archives with unit filter and visual charts.
user_flows: View dashboard stats via GET /api/dashboard -> See mail and archive statistics and KPI cards
Filter dashboard by unit via GET /api/dashboard?unit=<unit_id> -> See filtered KPIs and charts
Attempt to access dashboard without session via GET /api/dashboard -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> See authentication required error

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admin CRUD for user accounts with role assignment and activation/deactivation.
user_flows: List all users via GET /api/users -> See paginated list of users
Create new user via POST /api/users -> Receive 201 Created with user ID -> Get user via GET /api/users/:id -> See assigned role and unit
Update user role via PUT /api/users/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> Get user via GET /api/users/:id -> See updated role
Deactivate user via DELETE /api/users/:id -> Receive 204 No Content -> Attempt login as deactivated user via POST /api/auth/sign-in/email -> Receive 403 Forbidden
Attempt to create user with duplicate email via POST /api/users -> Receive 409 Conflict -> See error 'email already exists'

features.name: Classification Management (Klasifikasi)
features.description: Manage hierarchical archive classification codes used across the system and form mappings.
user_flows: List classification codes via GET /api/klasifikasi -> See hierarchical tree
Create classification code via POST /api/klasifikasi -> Receive 201 Created -> Get code via GET /api/klasifikasi -> See new node
Update classification via PUT /api/klasifikasi/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/klasifikasi shows updated node
Delete classification via DELETE /api/klasifikasi/:id -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/klasifikasi does not include deleted node
Attempt to delete classification that is in use via DELETE /api/klasifikasi/:id -> Receive 409 Conflict -> See error 'classification in use'

features.name: Record Retention Schedule (JRA)
features.description: Manage JRA retention schedules and map them to classification codes for automated retention handling.
user_flows: List retention schedules via GET /api/jra -> See list of JRA entries
Create retention schedule via POST /api/jra -> Receive 201 Created -> GET /api/jra/:id -> See retention details
Update retention schedule via PUT /api/jra/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/jra/:id -> See updated schedule
Delete retention schedule via DELETE /api/jra/:id -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/jra should not include removed schedule
Attempt to create retention schedule with missing fields via POST /api/jra -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> See validation error

features.name: Archive Lending (Peminjaman Arsip)
features.description: Manage borrowing requests for physical archives including approval, due-date tracking and returns.
user_flows: List lending records via GET /api/archive-lending -> See current lending requests and statuses
Create lending request via POST /api/archive-lending -> Receive 201 Created with request ID -> GET /api/archive-lending/:id -> See request details and status 'pending'
Approve lending request via PUT /api/archive-lending/:id (approve) -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/archive-lending/:id -> See status 'borrowed'
Return archive via PUT /api/archive-lending/:id (return) -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/archive-lending/:id -> See status 'returned'
Attempt to approve lending by unauthorized user via PUT /api/archive-lending/:id -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> See authorization error

features.name: Export
features.description: Export data (surat masuk, surat keluar, arsip) to Excel or PDF for reporting and regulatory forms.
user_flows: Export incoming mails to Excel via GET /api/export/surat-masuk?format=excel -> Receive 200 OK with Excel file
Export archives to PDF via GET /api/export/arsip?format=pdf -> Receive 200 OK with PDF file
Attempt export with unsupported format via GET /api/export/surat-masuk?format=xml -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> See error 'unsupported format'

features.name: Notifications
features.description: In-app notifications with read tracking and bulk clear operations.
user_flows: View notifications via GET /api/notifications -> See list of unread and read notifications
Mark notification as read via PUT /api/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/notifications shows notification as read
Clear all notifications via DELETE /api/notifications -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/notifications returns empty list
Attempt to mark non-existent notification as read via PUT /api/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 404 Not Found -> See error 'notification not found'

features.name: Global Search
features.description: Full-text search across mails and archives with keyword queries and result filtering.
user_flows: Search mails and archives via GET /api/search?q=keyword -> Receive 200 OK -> See matched results grouped by resource type
Refine search with filters via GET /api/search?q=keyword&type=arsip -> Receive 200 OK -> See filtered archive results
Attempt search with too-short query via GET /api/search?q=ab -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> See error 'query too short'
